notes.title: I Love Finding Critters is COMING SOON!
notes.notes:
The I Love Finding Animals series takes an exotic turn in the latest entry, [b]I Love Finding Critters![/b] 

In I Love Finding Critters, the new Hidden Object scenes and mini games come with a whole new set of friends. Unlike before though, these little guys are a whole lot weirder! From Betta fish to chameleons to even Axolotls, all our feisty new friends are dying to meet you!

I Love Finding Critters will launch on Steam with a 25% discount for a limited time only!

notes.title: First Time in Paris - Now Available!
notes.notes:
Our newest hidden object game, [b]First Time in Paris[/b], is now out on Steam! Play through gorgeous hidden object scenes and minigames as you join amateur travel blogger Kate Robinson and her daughter Nicole on their trip to see the sights of Paris and save a historic hotel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41643821/ed69c31d8080664220dfd1852f5965e69f2cf02a.png[/img]

Make sure you check First Time in Paris while it's still on 25% sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1767150/First_Time_in_Paris/

If you like hidden object games, check out one of our other franchises - [b]Faircroft's Antiques[/b]! Join antiquities expert Mia Faircroft as she searches through bright and beautiful locations, restore priceless antiques in exciting mini games, and meet interesting new people!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20414/Faircroft_Antiques/

notes.title: Threaded is Available NOW!
notes.notes:
[b]Threaded[/b] is a puzzle game that’s all about putting together pixel art pictures! Draw colorful links between different points, and complete lots of different original pixel artworks. Experience simple yet rewarding gameplay, soothing visuals and music, and even in-game trivia and fun facts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41643821/0b13d0fa012713895a5ff768013da6ef7af92638.png[/img]

Also newly released - [b]I Love Finding MORE Cats![/b]
Collect MORE adorable cats as you visit different locations, solve puzzles, and play minigames!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1767160/I_Love_Finding_MORE_Cats/
